feedback: The increased sensor count and forward shift in sensor positions improved early line detection but the robot still experiences line loss and steering oscillations, indicating the controller must compensate for increased sensor input complexity and slightly more forward sensing. The controller had to reduce base speed and PID gains to maintain stability, suggesting the geometry's wider sensor spread and forward placement increase sensitivity to noise and require gentler control. The lateral sensor positions are well balanced but could be slightly optimized to reduce oscillations further. Overall, the geometry helps by providing richer line information but demands a more cautious controller to avoid overshoot and line loss.
requested_changes: Adjust sensor x-positions to [-0.06,0.06] to slightly reduce lateral spread and test if steering oscillations decrease.
Try a sensor y-position forward shift of +0.01 (e.g. y positions around 0.07, 0.05, 0.03, 0.01, -0.01, 0.03, 0.05) to improve early line detection without excessive forward bias.
Test a slightly smaller sensor size of 0.012 to reduce noise sensitivity while keeping 7 sensors for coverage.
